تسلين (form I)
# تَسُلِّينَ (tasullīna) /ta.sul.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of سَلَّ (salla)
# تُسَلِّينَ (tusallīna) /tu.sal.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of سَلَّ (salla) and سُلَّ (sulla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
